instruction:
Treat `/home/user/Desktop/batch_base.fst`, `/home/user/Desktop/NRELOffshrBsline5MW_InflowWind_base.dat`, and a complete version-matched dependency closure as the starting point. Only initialization inputs are preloaded; generate all scripts and result artifacts yourself.

On this machine, the OpenFAST executable is `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/openfast` when working on `batch_base.fst`. Complete an automated steady-wind batch workflow from the command line: 1. Write `/home/user/Desktop/batch_run.py` to generate `NRELOffshrBsline5MW_InflowWind_WS.dat` and `case_wsWS.fst` under `/home/user/Desktop` for wind speeds 4, 8, 11, 15, and 20 m/s. Every InflowWind file must use `WindType=1` and its own `HWindSpeed`; every case must reference its matching input. Run the five 60-second cases serially, keeping every `.out` file and normal-termination log under `/home/user/Desktop`. 2. Write `/home/user/Desktop/batch_post.py` to locate the official output channels `GenPwr`, `RotSpeed`, and `BldPitch1` by header name and compute each channel's arithmetic mean over `Time>=50 s`. 3. Save `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` as `ws, genpwr_kw, rotspeed_rpm, bladepitch_deg`. 4. Do not use GUI tools.
